arxiv-1505-04807.title: Path Similarity Analysis: a Method for Quantifying Macromolecular Pathways
arxiv-1505-04807.creator: Sean L. Seyler
arxiv-1505-04807.description: Abstract Abstract Diverse classes of proteins function through large-scale conformational changes and various sophisticated computational algorithms have been proposed to enhance sampling of these macromolecular transition paths. Because such paths are curves in a high-dimensional space, it has been difficult to quantitatively compare multiple paths, a necessary prerequisite to, for instance, assess the quality of different algorithms.

arxiv-2004-00503.title: Deep Learning Approach for Enhanced Cyber Threat Indicators in Twitter Stream
arxiv-2004-00503.creator: Simran K, Prathiksha Balakrishna, Vinayakumar R, Soman KP
arxiv-2004-00503.description: Abstract In recent days, the amount of Cyber Security text data shared via social media resources mainly Twitter has increased. An accurate analysis of this data can help to develop cyber threat situational awareness framework for a cyber threat. This work proposes a deep learning based approach for tweet data analysis.

arxiv-2105-13428.title: Interacto: A Modern User Interaction Processing Model
arxiv-2105-13428.creator: Arnaud Blouin, Jean-Marc Jézéquel
arxiv-2105-13428.description: Abstract Since most software systems provide their users with interactive features, building user interfaces (UI) is one of the core software engineering tasks. It consists in designing, implementing and testing ever more sophisticated and versatile ways for users to interact with software systems, and safely connecting these interactions with commands querying or modifying their state.

arxiv-2106-06014.title: Bigraded differential algebra for vertex algebra complexes
arxiv-2106-06014.creator: A. Zuevsky
arxiv-2106-06014.description: Abstract . For an infinite chain bicomplex we show that the orthogonality and grading conditions provide it with the structure of a bigraded differential algebra with respect to a natural multiplication of several elements bicomplex spaces. Corresponding bigraded algebra commutation relations generate a sequence of non-vanishing cohomology invariants associated to vertex algebras.

arxiv-2303-01618.title: Deconstructing deep active inference.
arxiv-2303-01618.creator: Théophile Champion tmac3@kent.ac.uk, Marek Grześ m.grzes@kent.ac.uk, Lisa Bonheme lb732@kent.ac.uk, Howard Bowman H.Bowman@kent.ac.uk
arxiv-2303-01618.description: Abstract Active inference is a theory of perception, learning and decision making, which can be applied to neuroscience, robotics, psychology, and machine learning. Recently, intensive reasearch has been taking place to scale up this framework using Monte-Carlo tree search and deep learning. The end-goal of this activity is to solve more complicated tasks using deep active inference.

arxiv-2403-07677.title: Many-sided Poisson-Voronoi cells with only Gabriel neighbors xxx
arxiv-2403-07677.creator: H.J. Hilhorst
arxiv-2403-07677.description: Abstract Let p n G p_{n}^{G} be the probability for a planar Poisson-Voronoi cell to be n n -sided and have only Gabriel neighbors. Using an exact coordinate transformation followed by scaling arguments and a mean-field type calculation, we obtain the asymptotic expansion of log ⁡ p n G \log p_{n}^{\rm{G}} in the limit of large n n .

arxiv-2503-08259.title: Multitask Reinforcement Learning for Quadcopter Attitude Stabilization and Tracking using Graph Policy
arxiv-2503-08259.creator: Yu Tang Liu 1,2,3 , Afonso Vale 3 , Aamir Ahmad 2,1 , Rodrigo Ventura 3 , Meysam Basiri 3
arxiv-2503-08259.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yu Tang Liu 1,2,3 , Afonso Vale 3 , Aamir Ahmad 2,1 , Rodrigo Ventura 3 , Meysam Basiri 3. Quadcopter attitude control involves two tasks: smooth attitude tracking and aggressive stabilization from arbitrary states. Although both can be formulated as tracking problems, their distinct state spaces and control strategies complicate a unified reward function. We propose a multitask deep reinforcement learning framework that leverages parallel simulation with IsaacGym and a Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) policy to address both tasks effectively.

arxiv-2503-14856.title: Enhanced Astrometry of the Rapid ASKAP Continuum Survey for Precise Localisation of Fast Radio Bursts
arxiv-2503-14856.creator: Akhil Jaini, Adam T. Deller, Yuanming Wang, Emil Lenc, Marcin Glowacki
arxiv-2503-14856.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Akhil Jaini, Adam T. Deller, Yuanming Wang, Emil Lenc, Marcin Glowacki. Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) are short, intense radio signals from distant astrophysical sources, and their accurate localisation is crucial for probing their origins and utilising them as cosmological tools. This study focuses on improving the astrometric precision of FRBs discovered by the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) by correcting systematic positional errors in the Rapid ASKAP Continuum Survey (RACS), which is used as a primary reference for ASKAP FRB localisation.

arxiv-2506-12222.title: SSLAM: Enhancing Self-Supervised Models with Audio Mixtures for Polyphonic Soundscapes
arxiv-2506-12222.creator: Tony Alex, Sara Ahmed, Armin Mustafa, Muhammad Awais, Philip JB JacksonSurrey Institute for People-Centred AI, University of Surrey, Guildford, GU2 7XH, UKCentre for Vision, Speech and Signal Processing (CVSSP), University of Surrey {t.alex,sara.atito,armin.mustafa,muhammad.awais,p.jackson}@surrey.a
arxiv-2506-12222.description: Abstract Self-supervised pre-trained audio networks have seen widespread adoption in real-world systems, particularly in multi-modal large language models. These networks are often employed in a frozen state, under the assumption that the self-supervised pre-training has sufficiently equipped them to handle real-world audio.

arxiv-2508-14194.title: Algorithms for Stable Roommate with Externalities
arxiv-2508-14194.creator: Jing Leng, Sanjukta Roy
arxiv-2508-14194.description: Abstract In the roommate matching model, given a set of 2 ​ n 2n agents and n n rooms, we find an assignment of a pair of agents to a room. Although the roommate matching problem is well studied, the study of the model when agents have preference over both rooms and roommates was recently initiated by Chan et al.

arxiv-2602-08349.title: To Tango or to Disentangle? Making Ethnography Public in the Digital Age Journal: PACMHCI Volume: 10 2 CSCW040 4 DOI: 10.1145/3788076 CCS: Human-centered computing HCI theory, concepts and models CCS: Human-centered computing Empirical studies in HCI
arxiv-2602-08349.creator: Daniel Mwesigwa, Cyan DeVeaux, Palashi Vaghela
arxiv-2602-08349.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Daniel Mwesigwa, Cyan DeVeaux, Palashi Vaghela. Ethnography attends to relations among people, practices, and the technologies that mediate them. Central to this method is the duality of roles ethnographers navigate as researchers and participants and as outsiders and insiders. However, the rise of digital platforms has introduced new opportunities as well as practical and ethical challenges that reshape these dualities across hybrid media environments spanning both online and offline contexts.

britannica-1911-d-arblay-frances.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-d-arblay-frances.description: Article 'D'Arblay, Frances' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 7), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. diarist, better known as Fanny Burney, daughter of Dr 1 Charles Burney Burney, Charles (q.v.), was born at King’s Lynn, Norfolk, on the 13th of June 1752. Her mother was Esther Sleepe, granddaughter of a French refugee named Dubois. Fanny was the fourth child in a family of six.

pmc-10597197.title: The impact of socio-economic status on infant deaths: a case-control study from Istanbul
pmc-10597197.creator: S Girgin, I Ayvaz, N Bakir Keser, E Gemici, M A Sezerol, M Batman, O Karabacak, S Davun, S Hidiroglu, P Ay
pmc-10597197.description: BackgroundSocioeconomic disparities continue to impact child health. This study aimed to determine the association between socioeconomic status (SES) and infant mortality (IM) in a district in Istanbul.MethodsThis is a case-control study conducted in a district of Istanbul. The cases were all infants born alive who died before reaching the age of one between January 1, 2021, and December 31, 2022.

pmc-10636449.title: Decline of the chronic respiratory disease mortality in the WHO Western Pacific Region
pmc-10636449.creator: Nikolai Khaltaev, Svetlana Axelrod
pmc-10636449.description: BackgroundNon-communicable diseases (NCDs) are major cause of death all over the world killing 41 million of the 57 million deaths (72%) in 2016. According to World Health Organization (WHO) Director General the biggest decrease in NCD mortality between 2000 and 2019 globally were for chronic respiratory diseases (CRDs) a 37% decline.

pmc-11320848.title: Gd-EOB-DTPA enhanced MRI nomogram model to differentiate hepatocellular carcinoma and focal nodular hyperplasia both showing iso- or hyperintensity in the hepatobiliary phase
pmc-11320848.creator: Hao-yu Mao, Bin-qing Shen, Ji-yun Zhang, Tao Zhang, Wu Cai, Yan-fen Fan, Xi-ming Wang, Yi-xing Yu, Chun-hong Hu
pmc-11320848.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundTo develop and validate a nomogram model based on Gd-EOB-DTPA enhanced MRI for differentiation between hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and focal nodular hyperplasia (FNH) showing iso- or hyperintensity in the hepatobiliary phase (HBP).MethodsA total of 75 patients with 49 HCCs and 26 FNHs randomly divided into a training cohort (n = 52: 34 HCC; 18 FNH) and an internal validation cohort (n = 23: 15 HCC; 8 FNH).

pmc-11349948.title: Full-field optical coherence microscopy enables high-resolution label-free imaging of the dynamics of live mouse oocytes and early embryos
pmc-11349948.creator: Seweryn Morawiec, Anna Ajduk, Patrycjusz Stremplewski, Brendan F. Kennedy, Maciej Szkulmowski
pmc-11349948.description: High quality label-free imaging of oocytes and early embryos is essential for accurate assessment of their developmental potential, a key element of assisted reproduction procedures. To achieve this goal, we propose full-field optical coherence microscopy (FF-OCM), constructed as a compact module fully integrated with a commercial wide-field fluorescence microscope.

pmc-11411434.title: Massive water production from lunar ilmenite through reaction with endogenous hydrogen
pmc-11411434.creator: Xiao Chen, Shiyu Yang, Guoxin Chen, Wei Xu, Lijian Song, Ao Li, Hangboce Yin, Weixing Xia, Meng Gao, Ming Li, Haichen Wu, Junfeng Cui, Lei Zhang, Lijing Miao, Xiaoxue Shui, Weiping Xie, Peiling Ke, Yongjiang Huang, Jianfei Sun, Bingnan Yao, Min Ji, Mingliang Xiang, Yan Zhang, Shaofan Zhao, Wei Yao,
pmc-11411434.description: Finding water resources is a crucial objective of lunar missions. However, both hydroxyl (OH) and natural water (H2O) have been reported to be scarce on the Moon. We propose a potential method for obtaining water on the Moon through H2O formation via endogenous reactions in lunar regolith (LR), specifically through the reaction FeO/Fe2O3 + H → Fe + H2O.

pmc-11712401.title: Longitudinal Analysis of BCAA Levels and Hypometabolism in ApoE4‐Positive Alzheimer’s Patients Over A 48‐Month Period
pmc-11712401.creator: Jaipal Virdi, Daniel H. Silverman
pmc-11712401.description: BackgroundAlzheimer’s Disease (AD) is a chronic, incurable neurodegenerative condition characterized by extensive systemic, cellular, and molecular abnormalities. One such aspect recent studies have highlighted is the reduction in plasma branched‐chain amino acid (BCAA) concentrations, identifying them as a potential emerging marker for the disease.

pmc-12658708.title: Flow Process for Production of Crisaborole Using Organolithium Chemistry with Control over Impurity Formation
pmc-12658708.creator: Chander Singh Bohara, Manjinder Singh Phull, Srihari Pabbaraja
pmc-12658708.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Crisaborole, a distinctive boron-containing phosphodiesterase inhibitor, is used for the treatment of atopic dermatitis and eczema in adults and children. The development process for crisaborole involves organolithiation through a Br/Li exchange at −78 °C in batch mode. A continuous flow chemistry process was successfully developed for the synthesis of the key boronate intermediate of crisaborole, enabling efficient mixing, impurity control, and improved yield.

pmc-12967484.title: Expanding the Anatomical Distribution of PRRX1::KMT2D Fusion Mesenchymal Neoplasms: A Rare Mediastinal Case Report
pmc-12967484.creator: Weixiang Zhong, Yu Deng, Ke Sun
pmc-12967484.description: Background PRRX1‐rearranged mesenchymal neoplasms are rare soft tissue tumors with a predilection for the superficial subcutaneous tissue. The PRRX1::KMT2D fusion variant is exceptionally rare, with only three previously reported cases, all of which were located in the intermuscular regions. However, its occurrence in deep visceral sites has not been documented.

pmc-13096033.title: A pilot course on climate and health for students and faculty in the health professions
pmc-13096033.creator: Trisha Dalapati, Jennifer M. Lawson, John H. Lohnes, Allyson S. Sutkowi-Hemstreet, Perri A. Morgan, Denise M. Nepveux, Valerie K. Sabol, Andrew J. Muzyk, Brian G. McAdoo, AnnMarie L. Walton
pmc-13096033.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeManaging the health impacts of climate change will require the coordinated expertise of all health professions. Therefore, trainees and practitioners need to learn about climate change and its health impacts in an interprofessional setting.
